purpose: Predeclare a conservative mapping before any phyllary-posture history analysis so categories are not collapsed after seeing a phylogenetic signal.
reason: The conservative binary-compatible mapping leaves only two spreading/recurved tips and one cross-boundary ambiguous tip. This is too sparse and imbalanced to treat absence of repeated transitions as biological evidence.
next_data_priority: Collect direct voucher-linked phyllary posture/spread and spine measurements on the Japan-wide backbone; preserve continuous angle/spread where possible rather than forcing binary states.
claim_boundary: This mapping describes posture geometry only. It does not label either state as defensive, adaptive, stronger, or weaker, and it must not be altered after looking at a tree to increase transition count.
